key_expressions: How long does it take on foot?,

A: Excuse me, how can I get to the subway station?
Oh, so it’s not that far! I just walk straight that way?
Great, thank you! I’ll head there now.
B: The subway station? Yes, just go straight on this road.
Right, keep going until you see a big building, then turn left.
Sure, have a good trip!

A: Does this bus go to City Hall?
Oh, good! Where should I get off?
Great, thank you!
B: Yes, it does! This bus goes to City Hall.
Get off at the stop right in front of it. The announcement will tell you.
You're welcome!

A: Is there a bank near here?
Oh, down that way? Will I see it easily?
Alright! I’ll go check it out.
B: Yes, when this alley ends, it’s on your right.
You’ll see a big blue sign.
Go ahead!

A: Is the museum far from here?
Oh, that’s good to hear! It’s closer than I thought.
Thanks so much for the directions!
B: Not really. It’s about a 10-minute walk.
Cross the street and go left—you’ll see it right away.
Enjoy your visit!

A: Is this the right way if I keep going?
Oh, so I’m almost there?
Okay, I’ll keep walking a bit more.
B: Yes, this road leads to the main gate.
You’ll see it after about three more minutes.
You’re almost there—good luck!

A: Is there a pharmacy nearby?
Down that alley? I think I can find it!
Thank you, I’ll go right away.
B: Yes, go into that alley and it’s right there.
Look for a blue cross sign—you can’t miss it.
Take your time!

A: Um… how do I get to the park from here?
Oh! So I can take a bus?
Great, thanks for explaining!
B: The park is a bit far. Taking the bus is easier.
Yes, it’s just two stops away.
No problem at all!

A: Is there a restroom nearby?
Ah, inside the café? I should be able to find it!
Thanks a lot!
B: Yes, go inside that café.
It’s next to the stairs, so it’s easy to spot.
Go ahead!

A: Could you look at this map? I’m not sure where I am.
Oh! I was going the wrong way?
Thanks, now I know where to go.
B: Sure, where are you trying to go?
Yes, your destination is actually the opposite direction.
Hope you find it easily!

A: Is it easy to catch a taxi from here?
Ah! So I should go out to the main road?
Alright, I’ll head there now!
B: It’s a bit tough right here. It’s easier on the main road.
Yes, once you cross the street, lots of taxis pass by.
Have a great day!
